motherboard.ram: 32 x 64-Kbit DRAM = 256 KiB. Drawing: U2164; owner photo: M4164B-12.
motherboard.placement: v41 uses six nominal DIP lead rectangles across two owner photo planes, joined at the upper CTC. Independent lower CTC disagreement is 1.15 mm. motherboard.artwork: Additional visible component-side paths and twenty circular tinned lands traced from owner 073200542. No hidden routes or electrical netlist inferred.
motherboard.passives: Eleven lower-board resistors/capacitors registered from owner 073200542; nominal body dimensions and unknown electrical values.
motherboard.ribbon: Continuous board-to-drive-1-to-drive-0 chain, routed around display-board rear edge. Canonical path sections preserve browser ribbon width during inspection. Intermediate folds, available slack and separated-view extension remain illustrative. v42 removes a rear-wall crossing and inter-span crossing; both spans leave the shared drive plug at distinct heights. PSU lead-entry positions remain unresolved.
motherboard.detailPass: v42 prints only owner-photo-supported chip markings, without schematic designators or truncation. Package inspection includes photo crop, clean nominal model and separate marking/placement/identity confidence.
motherboard.mounting: v42 distinguishes two visible open holes from one visible upper-edge screw/washer. Two obscured legacy mounting locations remain estimated. See checks/mounting-audit.json; no hidden supports or thread dimensions measured.

keyboard.cpu: A5 U880 in schematic; UB880D in owner photo
keyboard.rom: A8 U556/U2716-compatible 2 KiB ROM; transplanted specimen ROM contents unverified

keyboard.transistors: Schematic: V4.1–V4.8 SC308C input stages, V3.1/V3.2 SC236D and V4.9 SC308C reset stages. L3/12 reference bodies at eleven named body-only photo estimates; all eleven schematic transistors still need native placement and individual lead mapping.

display.remaining: Local DACK response remains idealized at one byte per character clock. Individual dot timing, CPU contention, exact W/M clock/delays, light pen and CPU IRQ wiring remain unverified/unimplemented.
